description: Run tests as npx e2e run does and return what it printed: each test, the failures with their code frames, and the summary. Without files it runs every test the config discovers; files narrows to a test file, a directory, a glob, or one test (tests/checkout.e2e.ts:12). The run is the CLI's own, in its own process, with its workers, retries, replay cache, and report (.e2e/report.json by default); it needs no open session and leaves open sessions alone. One run at a time; cancelling the call interrupts it as Ctrl-C would. To fix a failing test, open_session {test: "<file>:<line>"} stops on the screen where it failed.

actionTimeout.description: Milliseconds each engine operation may take, such as a locator waiting for its element; 5000 while fixing a test

changedSince.description: Run the configured test filters on what differs from this git ref, such as origin/main

config.description: Path to an e2e config file, absolute or relative to the server's working directory; default: the server's --config, else the nearest e2e.config.ts

excludeTag.description: Leave out tests carrying any of these tags

files.description: What e2e run takes as positionals: files, directories, quoted globs, or file:line for the test declared on that line (tests/checkout.e2e.ts:12). Default: every test the config discovers

grep.description: Only tests whose title (describe titles and test title, space-joined) matches this regular expression

grepInvert.description: Leave out tests whose title matches this regular expression

headed.description: Show the browser or simulator while tests run, when the engine supports it; default: headless, unless the server was started with --headed

lastFailed.description: Only the tests the previous run did not pass

maxFailures.description: Stop the run once this many tests have failed

noCache.description: Run with the replay cache off, so every agent step calls the model

repeatEach.description: Run every selected test this many times, to measure a flaky one

retries.description: Retries per failing test; default: from the config. 0 while fixing a test

tag.description: Only tests carrying any of these tags

target.description: Target names to run on; default: the server's --target, else every target

updateSnapshots.description: Write the stored screenshots toHaveScreenshot finds missing or different, and pass

workers.description: Parallel workers; default: from the config

name: run_tests
